text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The tryouts finally roll around again.
This
is going to be the last scout
chance of the
year, so the runners are all fired up.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Good, no problems here. My legs are
warmed up and moving just
fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is her first time running in the
tryouts, so I was a little worried
that she'd get
nervous, but she seems relaxed and
focused.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To reduce the strain on her legs,
I did have her switch to dirt for just
this race, but she
doesn't look put off in the slightest. Her
mental strength goes above and beyond
what any trainer could hope for.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You don't need to worry anymore,
okay? I promise I'll win this.
And then, I'll
be ready to accept your offer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
However...
I'm afraid I'll have to decline.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I truly am flattered by your scout offer,
but the wind dances too high,
too far. I do
not believe I have reached a level
befitting you yet.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Instead, allow me to first run in the next tryout. This time, I will run, and I will win.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If you still wish to raise the wind
with me
then, I will gladly become
your trainee.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Just as I said, I'll make every effort to
display skill worth training, so
please look
forward to my run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's still her usual laid-back,
smiling self, but... something feels
different about her
today. I look her over, trying to discern
what.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, Trainer? Did I say
something strange?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The way you're staring at me is, well...
somewhat embarrassing. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She hasn't mentioned the wind a single time this whole conversation. I've gotten so used to it, it's kind of weird not hearing her metaphors.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Goodness, that surprised me. What's
got you so flustered?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...Still no wind analogies? Maybe she is nervous and is just bottling it up.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Of,
of course there isn't. I really am...
completely fine, so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I knew it.
She's not one to let her emotions
control her, but even she
gets butterflies.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I can do this. I know that I can.
I did all
that wonderful training with
your
guidance, after all...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She says it with almost desperate
insistence, like she's trying to
convince
herself. I rack my brain for what the
specific issue could be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While we didn't have the most time to
practice for this, she should still be in
really good shape. I know it's her first
time, but she's got
this—even if it is a dirt track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something tells me, though, that none of
that is what's eating at her. I
need to
reassure her about something deeper.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching over her for some time
now. Maybe, the best thing
I can say for
her as a trainer is...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The way she's focused right now, she's not
going to be able to run
wild like the wind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she wants to live up to her dream, she
has to let herself be free and
flexible—not
box herself into concrete goals and deals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The wind doesn't take just one shape or
form. It doesn't follow one
singular path to
its goal.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You think I'm... weighing down...
the wind?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Yes,
it does. You're absolutely right.
Soft or vicious,
straightforward or
unpredictable—it's all wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It was wrong of me to set ultimatums for
what my zephyr should be. I
should have
realized this sooner...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for opening my eyes, Trainer. I
see clearly at last. Yesterday's wind blew
yesterday. Today, I need think of nothing
but
the here and now.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Here and now, my heart is the calm
before the storm, an
easterly wind rising...
I'm starting to get excited.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Yamanin Zephyr takes to
the track for her first tryout!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They're rounding the third corner, passing
the 600-meter mark. Yamanin Zephyr is
still hanging towards the back.
Will she be able to
make up the gap?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (The wind has been a gentle zephyr...)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And they're rounding the fourth corner to
the final straight. Yamanin
Zephyr still
hasn't made a move! Can she catch up in
time?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(The eye of the storm has passed... and
now the winds rage!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The front of the pack is fighting for the
lead! Who's going to be the one to break
free?! Oh,
but wait! There's another runner
coming round the outside!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Now—my soul, a tempest!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Yamanin Zephyr! She's charging up
from the outside, reaching
third—now
second! She's going for the lead in one
sudden swoop!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And she does it! What crazy speed!
Yamanin Zephyr doubles her
length-long
lead aaand crosses the finish!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Did you see that? The way I ran!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Why, thank you. I've got a way to
go, though. The wind only
just started
blowing—a small zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
To raise this small current into a grand
gale... I need you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You really aren't like other trainers.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Still...
the tailwind carries new life across
the plains. When I think of
what pushes me
forth, the answer can be only you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to make the offer: please...
would you become my official
trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful! I'll be in your care, then.
Please watch over me as I pursue
the path
of the wind.
